name: share links are the only thing an anonymous visitor can see
description: ADR-0002: scorecards are fully gated. A logged-out visitor sees nothing, a contributor sees only their OWN rank, and the single publishable surface is a link the contributor generates and can revoke. The link exposes that contributor alone — no ranking against anyone else, no navigation outward.

steps._step: A contributor cannot browse to someone else's card either.

body.message: Scorecards are visible to verified hiring accounts only.

expect._note: Shown once. Stored hashed, so a database disclosure yields no working links.

steps._step: Anonymous, with the token — permitted, and scoped to Alice alone.

body._note_rank_absent: No rank field. A share link says how good you are, never where you sit against others.

steps._step: A contributor may see their own rank — and only their own.

body.message: Rankings are visible to verified hiring accounts only.
